# smsFreePHP

> A typed PHP 8.1+ client for the SMS4Free (sms4free.co.il) HTTP API. It sends SMS, parses and
> normalises Israeli phone numbers, counts SMS parts for Hebrew (UCS-2) text, and generates
> one-time passcodes. Composer package `edenohana/sms-free-php`, namespace `EdenOhana\SmsFree`,
> MIT licensed.

Install with `composer require edenohana/sms-free-php`. Requires PHP >= 8.1 and the `curl`, `json`
and `mbstring` extensions. Version 1.x exposed a global `SMSService` class; it still ships and still
works, but it is deprecated in favour of `Sms4FreeClient`.

## Minimal usage

```php
use EdenOhana\SmsFree\Credentials;
use EdenOhana\SmsFree\Sms4FreeClient;

$client = new Sms4FreeClient(Credentials::fromEnvironment()); // SMS4FREE_USERNAME/_PASSWORD/_API_KEY
$result = $client->send('MyShop', ['054-123-4567'], 'הקוד שלך הוא 123456');
$result->acceptedCount();
```

`send(string $senderName, iterable|string|PhoneNumber $recipients, string|Message $message)` returns
a `SendResult` or throws. It normalises and de-duplicates recipients, rejects the whole request if
any number is unparseable, and truncates an over-long body on a character boundary by default.

## Things that are easy to get wrong

- Failures are exceptions, not return values. `InvalidPhoneNumberException` (bad input, nothing
  sent), `ApiException` (the provider refused; carries `status()` and `providerMessage()`),
  `TransportException` (network or unreadable response), `InvalidArgumentException` (empty sender,
  recipients or body). All implement `SmsFreeException`.
- The provider's `status` field is the number of messages accepted, not a boolean. Any value of zero
  or below is a failure. Do not compare it against `1`.
- Hebrew is UCS-2, so only 70 characters fit in one SMS part instead of 160. Use
  `Message::of($text)->parts()` before sending if billing matters.
- Never cut a message body with `substr()`; it splits multibyte characters. Use
  `Message::truncateTo()`, or set `ClientOptions::withMessageTruncation(false)` to fail instead.
- Israeli mobile numbers are accepted in every common format (`054-123-4567`, `+972 54 123 4567`,
  `00972541234567`, `541234567`). `PhoneNumber::national()` is what the provider gets;
  `PhoneNumber::e164()` is what belongs in a database.
- The library never retries automatically, because a timeout does not prove the message was not
  sent. Retry at a layer that has an idempotency key.
- TLS verification cannot be disabled. Use `ClientOptions::withCaBundlePath()` for a host with a
  broken CA store.
- OTP codes are strings, not integers, so leading zeros survive. Compare them with
  `OtpGenerator::matches()`, which is constant time.
- On Laravel, the service provider is auto-discovered. Use the `sms4free` notification channel with a
  `toSms4Free()` method on the notification, and bind `HttpClient` to a fake in tests.
